goal: Make the entire Next.js app fully multilingual with locale-prefixed routing for English, French, Hindi, Sanskrit. All pages must live under the locale segment (/{locale}/...). Root (/) redirects to default locale (/en).

i18n_library.name: next-intl
i18n_library.reason: Modern App Router i18n via server request config + middleware + locale navigation helpers

includes: All UI strings translated (navigation, buttons, toasts, forms, errors, empty states)
excludes: Translating chess notation (SAN/PGN) and engine output text if it is already domain-standard

includes: Localize Learn/Tutorial lesson content stored in DB (Supabase) using JSONB fields or translation table

principles: No user-facing pages under src/app/ without locale prefix
URL locale is the source of truth; cookie is a preference for root redirects
Translations are message dictionaries (JSON) loaded per request
Server Components use server-loaded messages; Client Components use client provider hooks
Links and router navigation must be locale-aware (no hard-coded '/play' etc.)
routing_flow: Middleware ensures a valid locale prefix; redirects '/' -> '/en' and '/play' -> '/en/play'
Request config loads correct messages for the locale
Layout sets <html lang> and provides translations

files_to_update: src/app/layout.tsx (may become minimal or removed if you move all to [locale]/layout.tsx)
Any component containing hard-coded UI strings
disallowed_patterns_after_migration: Pages in src/app/* outside [locale] that are user-facing

key_rules: Keys must be stable and semantically named (no keys like 'text1')
No raw user-facing strings in components; everything via t('...')
Use interpolation params for dynamic text (e.g., {name}, {count})

fonts_and_typography.goal: Ensure Devanagari glyph coverage for Hindi/Sanskrit without tofu boxes.

approach.strategy: Use a Devanagari-capable font for hi/sa locales (or globally if simpler).

requirements: hi/sa pages must render Devanagari correctly in Header, Buttons, Lesson content, Game Review screens
No layout break due to longer translations (French often longer)

goals: If pathname does not start with '/en'|'/fr'|'/hi'|'/sa', redirect to '/en' + pathname
Optionally if request is '/', pick locale using cookie/Accept-Language and redirect to '/{locale}'
Avoid running on _next/static, images, favicon, robots, sitemap, and API routes
cookie_behavior: If path includes locale, set rg_locale cookie to that locale (so future '/' redirects respect it)
If user changes locale via switcher, switcher sets cookie and triggers navigation

requirements: Validate locale param is supported; otherwise 404 or redirect (prefer 404 inside route and middleware handles redirects)
Load messages for locale using next-intl request config
All Link components must be locale-aware (e.g., create a wrapper around next/link or use next-intl navigation helpers)
All router.push/replace must preserve locale and/or use locale-aware helpers
Language switcher must keep current pathname and swap the locale prefix

behavior_requirements: Navigate to same route under new locale
If current route does not exist in target locale (rare), fallback to /{locale}

goals: Ensure search engines understand each locale page is a localized variant (not duplicate content).
Ensure correct indexing and ranking per language.
Ensure correct social sharing metadata per locale.

requirements.title: Localized alternates (hreflang) for every indexable page
details: Each indexable page must include link rel='alternate' hreflang='en|fr|hi|sa' pointing to its translated equivalents.
Include an x-default alternate that points to the default locale landing (e.g., /en).
Alternates must exist for deep routes (not just home).
implementation_notes: Use Next.js App Router generateMetadata to emit alternates where possible.
Alternatively or additionally, emit hreflang via sitemap.

requirements.title: Correct canonical URLs per locale
details: Each locale page should use a self-referencing canonical URL by default (e.g., /fr/learn canonical is /fr/learn).
Do NOT canonicalize all locales to English unless you intentionally want only English to rank (usually not desired).
implementation_notes: Canonicals are a major signal for deduplication/canonicalization; wrong canonicals can collapse locale pages into one.

requirements.title: Localized metadata
details: Page <title>, description, and OpenGraph/Twitter fields must be translated per locale.
Metadata generation must be server-side using App Router metadata APIs.
implementation_notes: Use generateMetadata per route or per segment to pull translated strings.

requirements.title: Locale-aware sitemap + robots
details: Sitemap must include all locale-prefixed URLs.
If using hreflang in sitemap, include alternate links per URL entry.
robots.txt must allow crawling of locale pages.

source_guidance: Google Search Central recommends hreflang for localized versions and provides international/multilingual site guidance.
Google documentation explains canonicalization and canonical URL signaling.
Next.js App Router metadata APIs (generateMetadata) are the standard way to generate per-locale head metadata.

steps.title: Add next-intl and core i18n files
Move all pages under src/app/[locale]
actions: Create wrappers or move existing routes into src/app/[locale]/...
Ensure all old routes are removed or not user-facing
deliverables: Every page is reachable only under /{locale}/...

steps.title: Replace hard-coded links and strings
actions: Replace all hard-coded hrefs and router navigations with locale-aware helpers
Replace raw strings in UI with t('...')
Seed EN dictionary and add FR/HI/SA translations for critical screens
deliverables: No hard-coded UI strings in key flows (nav/auth/play/learn/game-review)

steps.title: Add language switcher + persistence
actions: Add LanguageSwitcher to header and/or settings

steps.title: Formatting + fonts + QA
actions: Add locale number/date formatting usage in key screens
Add Devanagari font support and test on Windows/Mac
Fix layout issues due to longer translations
deliverables: Visual and functional parity across all locales

optional_db_localization_v1_1.objective: Localize lesson/tutorial content stored in Supabase.

read_fallback_logic: When rendering a field, prefer i18n JSONB value for current locale, else fallback to English base column.

acceptance_criteria: All pages are accessible only under locale prefix: /en, /fr, /hi, /sa.
Visiting '/' redirects to '/en' (or to cookie-detected locale if enabled).
Language switcher swaps locale prefix and keeps the rest of the path intact.
No hard-coded user-facing strings remain in core flows; all use dictionary keys.
Hindi and Sanskrit render correctly (Devanagari) with no missing glyph boxes.
Locale-aware formatting is used for dates/numbers where shown.
Smoke tests pass for each locale for at least Home, Play, Learn, Game Review, Settings.

unit_tests: Path rewrite: switching locale preserves pathname correctly
e2e_smoke_tests_playwright: Open /en and verify nav label keys render correctly
Open /fr and verify French nav labels render
Deep route switch test: /en/games/123/review -> switch to fr -> /fr/games/123/review
manual_qa: Layout checks for long French strings
Font rendering on Windows and macOS
Check chess symbols rendering on all locales

must_generate: Concrete file implementations for middleware.ts, [locale]/layout.tsx, LanguageSwitcher.tsx
Initial dictionaries for en/fr/hi/sa with seeded keys
Refactors to remove hard-coded strings from nav + common components
must_not_do: Do not introduce non-locale routes for pages
Do not leave old non-prefixed links in components
Do not rely on Next.js legacy pages-router i18n settings
